## Overview
This document provides metadata, variable dictionaries, and summary statistics for the datasets associated with the manuscript. These datasets are archived for reproducibility and public access.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(labelled)
```

```{r load-data}
# Load the exported datasets
data_dir <- "output/publication_data"
df_pollen <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "pollen_deposition.csv"))
df_svd <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "SVD.csv"))
df_network <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "network_metrics.csv"))
```

---

## 1. Pollen Deposition Dataset (`pollen_deposition.csv`)
This dataset contains information regarding pollen deposition on individual stigmas of *Succisa pratensis* over three consecutive years.

### Data Dictionary
```{r dict-pollen}
var_label(df_pollen$year) <- "Year of sampling (2022-2024)"
var_label(df_pollen$id) <- "Unique sample identifier (Stigma ID)"
var_label(df_pollen$conspecific_pollen) <- "Count of conspecific (Succisa) pollen grains on stigma"
var_label(df_pollen$heterospecific_pollen) <- "Count of heterospecific (non-Succisa) pollen grains on stigma"

look_for(df_pollen, details = FALSE) %>%
  select(variable, label) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Variables in Pollen Deposition Dataset") %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "blue")
```

### Summary Statistics
```{r summary-pollen}
df_pollen %>%
  select(year, conspecific_pollen, heterospecific_pollen) %>%
  summary() %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

---

## 2. Single Visit Deposition (SVD) Dataset (`SVD.csv`)
This dataset contains experimental observations of pollen deposition resulting from a single, uninterrupted visit by various pollinator morphogroups to virgin *Succisa pratensis* inflorescences.

### Data Dictionary
```{r dict-svd}
var_label(df_svd$year) <- "Year of observation"
var_label(df_svd$id) <- "Unique sample identifier (Stigma ID)"
var_label(df_svd$morphogroup) <- "Functional group of the visitor (e.g., Eristalis spp., Bombus spp.)"
var_label(df_svd$duration_sec) <- "Duration of the single visit (seconds)"
var_label(df_svd$conspecific_pollen) <- "Conspecific pollen deposited during single visit (Count)"
var_label(df_svd$heterospecific_pollen) <- "Heterospecific pollen deposited during single visit (Count)"

look_for(df_svd, details = FALSE) %>%
  select(variable, label) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Variables in SVD Dataset") %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "green")
```

### Summary Statistics
```{r summary-svd}
df_svd %>%
  select(morphogroup, conspecific_pollen, heterospecific_pollen, duration_sec) %>%
  summary() %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

---

## 3. Network Metrics Dataset (`network_metrics.csv`)
This dataset aggregates plot-level and community-level metrics calculated from plant-pollinator interaction networks, floral abundance surveys, and overall stigmatic pollen loads.

### Data Dictionary
```{r dict-network}
var_label(df_network$Year) <- "Year of sampling"
var_label(df_network$H2) <- "Network Specialization index (H2')"
var_label(df_network$Succisa_H) <- "Interaction Evenness (Shannon's H)"
var_label(df_network$Succisa_d) <- "Interaction Specialization (d')"
var_label(df_network$Slope) <- "Slope (Beta) of the CP-HP relationship (Type 1 dynamics)"
var_label(df_network$Mean_HP) <- "Mean Heterospecific Pollen per stigma"
var_label(df_network$Succisa_Abundance) <- "Mean abundance of Succisa pratensis per plot"
var_label(df_network$Total_Abundance) <- "Total floral abundance in the community"

look_for(df_network, details = FALSE) %>%
  select(variable, label) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Variables in Network Metrics Dataset") %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "gray")
```

### Summary Statistics
```{r summary-network}
df_network %>%
  select(Year, H2, Succisa_H, Slope, Mean_HP, Succisa_Abundance) %>%
  summary() %>%
  knitr::kable()
```
